parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json||{});const first=rows[0]||{};const operation=String(first.requestType||'');const isNotFound=e=>/table.*not found|does not exist|unknown table/i.test(String(e||''));const errors=rows.filter(r=>r.error&&!isNotFound(r.error)).map(r=>({tableName:r.tableName,error:r.error}));if(errors.length)throw new Error(`privacy_data_tables_adapter_failed_closed:${JSON.stringify(errors)}`);const targets=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.tableName).filter(Boolean))];if(targets.length<13)throw new Error('privacy_data_tables_target_coverage_incomplete');if(operation==='delete'){const remaining=rows.filter(r=>r.recordPresent===true).map(r=>r.tableName);if(remaining.length)throw new Error(`privacy_data_tables_delete_readback_not_empty:${remaining.join(',')}`);return [{json:{adapter:'data_tables',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_data_tables_privacy_receipt_v3',operation,verifiedDeletedTables:targets,verifiedAbsent:true,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}];}if(operation==='preview'){const counts={};for(const r of rows)counts[r.tableName]=(counts[r.tableName]||0)+(r.recordPresent?1:0);return [{json:{adapter:'data_tables',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_data_tables_privacy_receipt_v3',operation:'preview',verifiedTables:targets,rowCounts:counts,mutated:false,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}];}const grouped={};for(const r of rows){if(!grouped[r.tableName])grouped[r.tableName]=[];if(r.row)grouped[r.tableName].push(r.row)}return [{json:{adapter:'data_tables',success:true,retryable:false,receipt:{contractVersion:'chelsea_data_tables_privacy_receipt_v3',operation:'export',tables:grouped,verifiedTables:targets,completedAt:new Date().toISOString()},errorMessage:''}}];
